BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, yiphʻâh means splendour, beauty. In Ezekiel 28:7, they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and it appears again in Ezekiel 28:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe yiphʻâh still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
